verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no training-data policy, opt-out control, or no-training commitment for Cactus, including its hosted platform that accepts uploaded data and can route queries to the cloud. The on-device claim that 'no data leav[es] the device' is an adjacent architectural property, not a documented guarantee that user data is excluded from model training, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
